prose.text: The chunk's own probes and pins come first, then the window app's smoke, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order (`capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step, the base-identity bindings close, since the chunk adds no procedure), then the local pre-push check, then the operator pass.

**The window app's smoke** is owed because `pulse-app/src/main.rs` and `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` change (test-plan §3 Boot-smoke gate). It is the harness series of two boots on this host in its recorded form: each boot under its own virtual display, the receivers moved to 14317 and 14318 so the shared ports 4317 and 4318 are never bound, `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` unset, a fresh data dir under `target/boot-smoke/` named at invocation. The same statement then reads each boot's kept log for the new boot record with `program` `window`.

**The console program's own run** is `integration_console_engine`, a test in the workspace run. It binds two ports it picks and never 4317 or 4318. CI's `lint-test` job and the pre-push check's `test` stage run it with no display variable and no session bus, with no workflow edit.

Absences, each with its reason: - No webview gate and no headful self-verify: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched and no rendered surface   changes. The `a11y` job's verdict is read from the operator pass's run. - No local `cargo audit` or `cargo deny` entry: no dependency is added and the scope guard holds `Cargo.lock`   unchanged; the `supply-chain` job reads both on the operator pass's run. - Left for the next entries, none of it built here: the harness verbs aimed at the console program and the   checks that grade its log (`Agent harness drives the console engine`); the door, and the end of the stdio   sidecar (`Door inside the engine's process`); the scenario legs (`Scenario legs driven against the console   engine`); operator-set places for stores, log and pid (`One place on a node`); a CI step and a kept console   log (`Engine end-to-end gate reachable`); an incident from real telemetry read back (`Detection baseline   through the console engine`). - No panic is induced in the console program itself: it has no switch that induces one, and a test-only switch   in a product binary is not built. The panic record and the at-exit record are witnessed through the   process-start function it calls, in re-exec children (step 9). - No retry anywhere. The boot job is read once; a boot that ended by itself stops the pass and goes to the   operator.

**The operator pass, in this order.** The hygiene entry; the pre-CI commit; the local pre-push check again; the merge-base probe; the build-branch push; the CI read of the pushed tip, asserted green, its row naming every check read; the run's `logs-boot-Linux` artifact, with the series verdict, the smoke's settle verdict, every kept witness file read whole and the window's boot record. A line of a witness file holding anything beyond its shape stops the pass. A red is fixed by a further commit on top and read again.
